video.encoder: libx264 crf 27 (2.3 Mbps cap), faststart — sized to play inline in the GitHub file viewer

audio.note: no narration; no third-party audio; every clip procedurally authored and mixed by the RakuAI audio runtime; one linear gain and a peak limiter applied at mux

world_footage: every frame rendered by the RakuAI runtime (Direct3D 11) on an NVIDIA GPU; physics by the RakuAI physics runtime on the CPU; on-screen text composited afterwards
public_derivative: overlays generalized for publication: the initial and final control error are shown; intermediate measurements, command parameters, transport internals and model reasoning are not
